PLAN "Pregnancy Strength — 12 Week"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and function during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Weeks 1-4 (adaptation, safe loading)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          sumo_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x20..30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt 5m
    WEEK 3:

    WEEK 4:

  PHASE "Phase 3 — Weeks 9-12 (maintain, taper intensity, prepare for postpartum)" (4 weeks):
